Chapter 1124 40: The Shocked King Chibao (Request For Subscription)

Chapter 1124 40: The Shocked King Chibao (Request for Subscription)

"The war is over?"

A few young men and women looked at the red-bearded old man.

They had just arrived, and the war was over?

And how did the war end?

Which side won?

"King Lingshen is dead, killed by a strong warrior called 'Galaxy'."

The red-bearded old man patiently explained.

Just now, King Chisong had already informed him of the latest intelligence from the battlefield.

And even without King Chisong, he would soon learn of such matters.

"King Lingshen is dead?"

The young men took a deep breath.

Now Qingfen City was safe and sound, yet the red-bearded old man said the war was over.

They vaguely speculated that perhaps an unforeseen turn of events on the battlefield led to King Lingshen's defeat.

But the red-bearded old man said, King Lingshen is dead?

Dead and defeated are completely different matters.

According to the information they received—

King Lingshen was a core royal clan member who had grown to his limits.

Such a powerful warrior, who could kill him?

A Heavenly Venerate?

The entire Fierce Sun Ancient Country only had a few Heavenly Venerates, each with a renowned name, and none called 'Galaxy'.

"Did Chisong say that 'Galaxy' is from our Fierce Sun Ancient Country's core royal clan?"

The red-bearded old man pondered in his mind; now that the war was over, and it ended with the Fierce Sun Ancient Country's victory, he was not in any rush.

"Which clansman could it be?"

The red-bearded old man was curious; indeed, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country had some ancient core royal clan members who traveled abroad, attempting to find ways to break the chains of their bloodline.

"Come, let's pay a visit."

The red-bearded old man glanced at the young men beside him, got up, and flew toward the battlefield.

Since he was here, he also wanted to meet the core royal clan member King Chisong mentioned.

After all, this 'Galaxy' who decisively killed King Lingshen, his strength must far exceed a core royal clan member's limits.

...

On the battlefield.

Lin Yuan was casually chatting with King Chisong and King Chijue.

"If it weren't for Senior Galaxy's intervention, the Qingfen Domain and several dozen surrounding domains would surely be lost," King Chisong said with emotion, "Senior Galaxy's kindness to me is truly immense."

Although the war failed, it was partly because King Lingshen's strength exceeded expectations.

But a loss is a loss; having lost dozens of large domains of territory, King Chisong would certainly have to go to the capital for punishment.

"It's not a matter of kindness," Lin Yuan shook his head.

Even without King Chisong, he wouldn't have stood by and watched Qingfen Domain fall.

"To you, Senior Galaxy, it may not be much, but to me, it's an enormous kindness." King Chisong spoke solemnly: "But I'm not sure how I should thank you, Senior."

"Treasures and rare items? Senior Galaxy surely wouldn't care for them, and what Senior Galaxy desires, I can't provide."

King Chisong himself is just an ordinary royalty, his strength slightly stronger than the peak of a Great Lord but far off from extreme core royalty.

With such a disparity in power, what looks like a treasure to King Chisong, to Lin Yuan, naturally isn't worth considering.

"So I've decided to forgo all merits from this war and transfer them all to Senior Galaxy, allowing you to choose from the national treasury in the capital." King Chisong proposed.

This war to resist the Da Ling Ancient Country's invasion, King Chisong as the highest commander, would be punished for losing.

But if they won, he would surely receive massive rewards.

Unlike powerful figures like Lord Qingfen and Great Venerate Hongye,

They would receive rewards given by King Chisong himself.

While the rewards King Chisong received came directly from the Fierce Sun capital.

The Fierce Sun capital is the core of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, where countless treasures of this source world converge, highly coveted even by Heavenly Venerate-level powerhouses.

"If you give me your merits, what will you do?"

Lin Yuan looked at King Chisong.

"Without Senior Galaxy, I wouldn't even have merits to speak of and would already be on my way to receive punishment."

King Chisong said: "I am already very satisfied with the current outcome, besides this war's merits, I really don't know what else could repay Senior."

"Senior Galaxy, please accept it. Without you, Chisong would have faced punishment and I would have suffered great losses too." King Chijue chimed in.

At the very least, his primary battle body would definitely have been destroyed by King Lingshen.

His personal weapons would not be preserved, plus the time and effort needed to cultivate a new primary battle body.

Thinking about it, King Chijue felt fortunate.

If it weren't for Lin Yuan's intervention, the consequences would be unimaginable.

Lin Yuan looked at King Chisong's resolute expression, pondered for a while, and nodded, saying: "In that case, I will accept it."

"I am glad Senior accepted."

King Chisong's face broke into a smile.

"By the way," King Chisong seemed to recall something and immediately said: "Senior, King Chibao wishes to meet you."

"King Chibao?"

Lin Yuan looked at King Chisong.

"As soon as King Lingshen revealed their extreme core royal strength, I immediately requested reinforcement from the capital."

King Chisong explained: "King Chibao is the strong warrior sent from the capital, specifically to counter King Lingshen."

"I see."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Specifically counter King Lingshen?

Either an equal extreme core royal or a Heavenly Venerate.

Lin Yuan speculated the latter was impossible; dispatching Heavenly Venerate-level force lightly in such a local war could very well drive the situation toward an unpredictable development.

So, he is probably an ultimate core royal family member as well.

"King Chibao is here."

Red Pine King looked toward Qingfen City, where at this moment a red-bearded elder's figure appeared, and then he flew over in this direction.

After approaching a certain distance, the red-bearded elder no longer continued to teleport through space, but flew directly over.

"An ultimate core royal family member?"

Lin Yuan looked at the red-bearded elder from afar, faintly sensing a terrifying aura emanating from him.

It was a terrifying aura not weaker than King Lingshen's.

Soon enough.

The red-bearded elder approached.

"This must be the Galaxy brother."

The red-bearded elder, known as King Chibao, looked at Lin Yuan with a smile.

"Let's go, we'll talk more slowly when we get back."

Red Pine King, standing by, said, "I have already ordered someone to prepare a special top-grade meal for us, so we can chat while we eat."

Red Pine King had already arranged everything and immediately took Lin Yuan and others to his temporary small city cave residence.

...

Yu Family.

Several old ancestors along with Yu Chaolong also received detailed intelligence reports about the war between Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain.

The war between the two major domains determined the future destiny of their families, so the Yu Family was naturally extremely concerned.

"What?"

Yu Chaolong looked at the intelligence report in front of him, somewhat unable to react.

In the war between the two domains, Galaxy Great Venerate suddenly took action, with an absolutely overwhelming stance, swept across the entire battlefield, and even the core royal family member King Lingshen died at the hands of Galaxy Great Venerate.

This kind of news, which could be described as 'shocking,' would definitely spread throughout the entire Qingfen Domain at the fastest speed.

After all, the fact that a core royal family member of Da Ling Ancient Country had died on the battlefield was sure to boost morale.

However—

Yu Chaolong and several old ancestors were left with a head full of confusion.

"Galaxy Great Venerate?"

"How come this Galaxy Great Venerate sounds so familiar?"

"Galaxy Great Venerate? I remember that Yan's Great Venerate title was 'Galaxy'?"

In fact, upon seeing the words Galaxy Great Venerate, they had already associated it with Lin Yuan.

Especially several of Yu Family's old ancestors, as twelve-layer Self-Dao Realm practitioners, their minds worked at lightning speed. How could an incident familiar to them appear?

It wasn't familiarity but disbelief.

Because the deeds of that Galaxy Great Venerate in the intelligence report were simply unbelievable.

King Lingshen had grown to become an ultimate core royal family member.

Claimed to be invincible among the Great Lords.

Yet he perished at the hands of Galaxy Great Venerate?

This Galaxy Great Venerate, is it really Yu Yan whom they knew?

"Could there be some misunderstanding?"

Yu Chaolong couldn't help but say; the content of the intelligence report was truly incredible, leading him to start doubting its truth.

"Not a misunderstanding."

"A Great Venerate has personally contacted me."

An ancestor of the Yu Family spoke with a trembling voice, even though the Yu Family had produced Yu Yan, a new Great Venerate, other Great Lords wouldn't contact the Yu Family without reason.

How significant is the status of a Great Venerate? How many are there in a major domain?

"This this this..."

Yu Chaolong was in disbelief.

"It's still necessary to personally confirm this."

Another Yu Family ancestor looked at Yu Chaolong, "Chaolong, later you will need to go to Qingfen City personally to see what the situation really is."

"Yes."

Yu Chaolong steadied his mind; he also wanted to know if the Galaxy Great Venerate in the intelligence report, seemingly like a god, was really his son.

...

Inside the temporary small city cave of Red Pine King.

In a luxurious pavilion.

Lin Yuan and King Chibao sat facing each other.

As for Red Pine King, King Chijue? After chatting for a while and seeing that King Chibao and Lin Yuan had something to discuss, the two kings sensibly withdrew.

"Galaxy brother, you shouldn't be a core royal family member on a journey, right?" King Chibao looked at Lin Yuan, testingly asked.

Red Pine King and King Chijue hadn't reached the level of realization; King Chijue, although a core royal family member, hadn't grown to the ultimate level and hadn't accessed much information.

So they believed Lin Yuan to be some ultimate core royal family member traveling by chance through Qingfen Domain.

But King Chibao? As an ultimate core royal family member, King Chibao knew most of the ultimate core royal family members of the Ancient Country and found none resembling Lin Yuan.

"Yes."

Lin Yuan admitted frankly, "I've been cultivating in the past, condensing Seeds of the Fierce Sun one by one, and hence have acquired my current strength."

Lord Qingfen believed Lin Yuan's bloodline experienced regression to an ancestral level, reaching the core royal family tier.

Lin Yuan now followed Lord Qingfen's conjecture to explain himself, presenting as a fortunate individual whose bloodline regressed to an ancestral state.

Fierce Sun Ancient Country had existed for countless ages, similar situations had indeed occurred where an individual's bloodline underwent regression to the core royal family level, eventually leading to their rise.

This was also the most suitable and indisputable explanation for Lin Yuan, as condensing Seeds of the Fierce Sun itself was beyond ordinary logic, something fundamentally unattainable for outsiders, except for core royal family members.

"So that's the case..."

King Chibao immediately accepted Lin Yuan's explanation, able to sense the abundant Fierce Sun aura from this Galaxy Great Venerate.

"Even if the bloodline regressed to the core royal family tier, achieving this level of cultivation without external inheritance aid..."

King Chibao looked solemnly at Lin Yuan.

Even those born within the core royal family in Ancient Country, enjoying all sorts of external supports,

could find it challenging to reach the ultimate level. King Chijue was an example of this.

But Lin Yuan? He had a regressed bloodline, received no external aid since childhood, yet achieved his current level...

King Chibao looked at Lin Yuan with eyes filled with awe.
